[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run2]
`:resource.google_folder_iam_binding.authoritative` sets IAM on the folder via `folder = local.folder.name`, but the graph shows no dependency on `:resource.google_folder.folder`. The folder must exist (and be ready) before its IAM policy can be authoritative-bound; this operational ordering is only hidden inside the `local.folder` conditional and should be made explicit, e.g. `depends_on = [google_folder.folder]`.
